author: user
message: pytest check: create the bindings' venv when missing, so the full check works in a fresh worktree

check.name: pytest
check.run: cd bindings/python && cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings && uv venv .venv --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv maturin numpy scipy pytest && uv run --no-project --python .venv maturin develop --release --uv && uv run --no-project --python .venv python -m pytest tests -q
check.notes: makes the bindings' venv itself when it's missing (a fresh worktree has none: it's gitignored), so the full check runs anywhere; AUTODYNE_IREE_DIR enables the flux backend test
